messages:
nick: Uploaded the monthly recurrence snapshot and highlighted top repeat causes (drains, backpressure, kv-cache). Link: https://drive.redwood/incidents/monthly-184701
maya: thanks. can we turn these into an actionable playbook list? unclear ownership across infra/runtime.
raj: I'll own playbook for drains. will include pre-check, rollback, and verification steps.
maya: I'll take backpressure playbook; plan: proxy shortfix + runtime change, staged canary.
nick: added a small impact score col and suggested owners in the sheet. please confirm ownership by EOD so we can publish the playbooks before next oncall rotation.
ops-bot: Reminder: add JIRA link to each action before marking in-progress.
raj: confirmed. creating JIRA and will link tracker.
maya: confirmed. will add monitoring runbooks and thresholds.
nick: propose monthly 30m sync for the top 5 patterns and a quarterly deep-dive. agree?
raj: +1 30m is enough.
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Recurrence Playbook Sync  2026-04-12 15:00 UTC
nick: closing thread; we'll track progress in the tracker and retro notes.
